items.reasoning: Using Mode B (mechanism analysis), the report faithfully implements all core components of Depth Cascade Matching—partitioning tracklets and detections into pseudo-depth intervals, performing pure IoU-based Hungarian matching within each depth level without appearance features, and cascading unmatched objects sequentially from near to far. Beyond reproducing DCM and sweeping depth levels and thresholds, the report provides significantly deeper mechanistic analysis than the original paper by introducing random-partition and reverse-order (far-to-near) controls, quantifying the exact trade-off between candidate sparsification and boundary-induced splitting of true pairs, and demonstrating a pairwise relative depth-gating alternative that eliminates greedy boundary errors in extreme crowds.
